```{r}
library(scatterplot3d)
options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)
library(rgl)
library(dbscan)
library(kneedle)
library(umap)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer) 
```


```{r}
# read file and assign clusters as we can, as well as species name
set.seed(42) # Set seed for reproducibility

file_number <- 0L
base_path <- sprintf("../../../new_data/2024_12_29_17_15_load_long/SummaryIndividuals_%d.csv", file_number)
df = read.csv(base_path)

# decimate file for easy analysis
decimate_p = 0.001
n = round(length(df$ID)*decimate_p)

# random subset
sample_vector=c(1:nrow(df))
# sample elements from the vector (in this example 30 elements sampled without replacement)
the_sample = sample(sample_vector, n, replace=FALSE)
# the vector of randomly selected elements is then used to select rows from the dataframe
world = df[the_sample,]

```


```{r}

close3d()
plot3d(x= world$created, y=world$pgmDeath, z = world$maxEnergy,
       col = "black")
points3d(x= world$created, y=world$pgmDeath, z = world$maxEnergy,
       col = "red", main = "folder", xlim = c(0, max(world$created)))

rglwidget()

```


UMAP 

```{r}
select_columns = c("maxEnergy", "pgmDeath")
df_stripped = world[, select_columns]

umap_res <- umap(df_stripped, n_components = 2)
umap_embedding <- umap_res$layout 
umap_plot_df = data.frame(UMAP1 = umap_embedding[,1], UMAP2 = umap_embedding[,2])
```

Plot 

```{r}
ggplot(umap_plot_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "UMAP Projection of Agent Attributes")
```

PCA


```{r}
# Apply PCA display clusters
#"sensors", , "speed", "kidEnergy", "nkids", "sensors", "matForKids")
pc <- prcomp(world[c("pgmDeath","maxEnergy")],
             center = TRUE,
            scale. = TRUE)

library(ggfortify)
summary(pc)
autoplot(pc)
```

```{r}
# Plot principal components
plot(pc$x[,1])
plot(pc$x[,2])
# plot(pc$x[,3])
```

 Assign clusters
 
```{r}
# all before 5K are LUCA
df$Cluster = 0
df$species = "neo-LUCA"

```

```{r}
out_path = sprintf("../../../new_data/2024_12_29_17_15_load_long/SummaryIndividuals_%d_with_clusters.csv", file_number)
write.csv(df, out_path, row.names = FALSE)
print(out_path)
```
